archetypes.name: token-env
archetypes.rationale: Active-ledger attribution depends on precise env scrubbing across Bash and Python paths.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the token sidecar ingestion paths for stale environment leakage and ledger mis-attribution. Check Bash env -u usage, Python env dictionaries, and tests that assert stale parent token variables are ignored. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: fallback-freshness
archetypes.rationale: Output fallback ingestion can double-count stale sidecars if freshness gates regress.
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on Python CI-fix output fallback behavior. Verify Codex and Cursor may use fresh output sidecars when stdout omits TOKEN_RECORD, while Claude does not fallback-ingest output sidecars. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: validation-parity
archetypes.rationale: Validation prompt-side ingestion should stay aligned with research candidate expansion.
archetypes.prompt_body: Compare validation-phase sidecar ingestion prose with the existing research-phase candidate expansion. Confirm REVIEWER_FILE, fixed outputs, retry outputs, non-substantive retry outputs, dedupe, and clean research ledger env are all represented. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
